instruction:
Use Abaqus/CAE through the graphical user interface to complete the following task. Use the N-mm-MPa unit system.

Model Definition:
Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Extrusion. Build a straight rectangular bar with length 100 mm along the global X-axis. The cross-section is a 10 mm x 10 mm square in the Y-Z plane, so the final geometry occupies X = 0 to 100 mm, Y = 0 to 10 mm, and Z = 0 to 10 mm.

Material and Section:
Define a material named Steel with Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3. Create a Solid Homogeneous section using Steel and assign it to the entire bar.

Assembly:
Create one dependent instance of the bar.

Analysis Step:
Create a Static, General step named Step-Load, placed after the Initial step.

Loads and Boundary Conditions:
Apply an Encastre boundary condition to the end face at X = 0. Apply a tensile Surface Traction, General to the end face at X = 100 mm. Set the traction magnitude to 10 MPa acting in the global positive X direction. This traction is equivalent to a total tensile force of 1000 N distributed over the 10 mm x 10 mm end face.

Discretization:
Mesh the bar with a global seed size of 5 mm. Assign the element type C3D8R and generate the mesh.

Job Execution:
Create a job named Job-Tension, submit it for analysis, and wait for the analysis to complete successfully.

Post-Processing:
Open the output database. Display the Mises stress contour. Query the U1 displacement at the node located at the center of the free end face (X = 100 mm, Y = 5 mm, Z = 5 mm).

Deliverables:
Save the model database as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Tension.cae and ensure the output database is generated as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Tension.odb.
